stateDiagram-v2
  [*] --> Active: publish current occurrence
  Active --> Active: update same occurrence and valid source
  Active --> Acknowledged: dismiss ongoing condition
  Active --> Recent: transient expiry or dismiss
  Active --> Recent: resolved or superseded
  Active --> Recent: scope disposed or source invalidated
  Acknowledged --> Acknowledged: identical projection or replay
  Acknowledged --> Recent: source confirms resolution or invalidation
  Recent --> [*]: retention limit
  state Active {
    [*] --> Eligible
    Eligible --> Primary: priority and context selection
    Primary --> Eligible: more urgent notice
  }
  note right of Active
    Progress ends from command outcome or unavailable status.
    Old occurrence updates and timers are ignored.
    Hover or focus pauses only transient expiry.
    Source invalidation always wins.
  end note
  note right of Acknowledged
    Excluded from primary message.
    Still in Active count and owning surface.
    Dismissal is not domain resolution.
  end note
  note right of Recent
    Never replay into Active.
    True recurrence publishes a new occurrence.
    Maximum 50 redacted summaries for 24 hours in session memory.
  end note

data.title: Desktop notification relevance and dismissal lifecycle
